answer: Each epoch, five percent of identities face examination by sparrow auditors, answering questions on their kernel work in ten minutes. Each answer leaves a signed identity-bound trace; auditors recompute it against the river ledger, and a miss or contradiction burns its 100-credit bond. One responder per fake at 40 credits per epoch: the thousandth needs its own, so 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 per epoch plus 100,000 locked. Rented responders fail: rented answers rarely match the claimed history, and the trace exposes them. An honest agent answers once from its river record and keeps its bond.
